BiblicalUsage: The word is a divination, an augury, and it appears twice in Ezekiel's sentence on the false prophets: there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination in Israel, and those who spoke lying divinations are exposed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the end of divination is good news: God's people do not need fortune-tellers, because God speaks plainly to His prophets.
